DIAGNOSIS READY: Postpartum Endometritis with possible Pelvic Abscess.

The combination of prolonged labor, an 11-pound infant, uterine tenderness, decreased bowel sounds, and fever is highly suggestive of endometritis, potentially complicated by a pelvic abscess or urinary retention. We have requested your CBC, CRP, and Urinalysis; please also request images of a Pelvic Ultrasound to evaluate for abscess formation or uterine pathology.
